```text
# #5012: Patch: the palette's status colors drawn from the table's materials, not Tailwind's defaults
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

`apps/web/src/palette.css` holds two families. The wood, brass, gold and parchment entries are JackiOh's own. About twenty others are Tailwind's default palette, value for value:

- grey-500 `#6b7280`
- red-300/400/500/900 (`#fca5a5` `#f87171` `#ef4444` `#7f1d1d`)
- orange-400 `#fb923c`
- lime-200/400
- green-200/400/500/700/900 (`#22c55e`, `#4ade80`, …)
- yellow-400 `#facc15`
- gold-200 `#fde68a` (Tailwind's amber-200)
- cyan-400 `#22d3ee`
- sky-300/400
- blue-200/700/900
- violet-300/500/700
- purple-400

Next to the wood, these read as neon, and they are the first thing that makes the client look generic and generated.

Replace them with colors drawn from the table's materials, as `--pal-jade-400` and `--pal-ember-500` already are:

- a jade for good and ready
- an oxblood or lacquer red for damage and danger
- an ink or slate blue for information
- verdigris or tarnished brass for the rest

Warm and desaturate them so they sit on parchment and wood. End with fewer entries than today. Each name keeps the meaning its uses give it (health, damage, mana, rarity, keyword and team colors); where the spec or a ruling names a color, keep what it names.

Then migrate the sheets with the most literals onto the palette: `cards/cards.css` (231), `cards/inspect/inspect.css` (80), `game/board.css` (74), `game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` (64), `game/table.css` (56), `routes/stats.css` (52) and onward. The palette test's `UNMIGRATED` allowlist (43 sheets, 1,870 literals today) shrinks as they go. A cosmetic a player owns (`cards/cosmetics.css`) keeps its look, though its literals may move onto palette names.

## Acceptance

- `palette.test.ts` fails if any `--pal-*` value equals one of the Tailwind default values listed above (a test that names them).
- `PALETTE_MAX` is lowered to the new count, and the AA text-contrast test still passes.
- `UNMIGRATED`'s total is at most 935 (half of today's), and no entry grows.
- The web's unit tests, typecheck and `pnpm --dir e2e test:component` pass. Pixel baselines that change on purpose are re-recorded in the same pull request.
- If the classifier calls it a card change (`apps/web/src/cards/`), it ships with a `--visual` pending fragment and a hand-written player note (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`).

## Notes

This is part of a pass to make the client look made on purpose rather than built from defaults. Its siblings cover type, effects, corners and icons, and all of them touch the same sheets, so expect merge conflicts between them.
```
